description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Speedometer Cable for the Suzuki Samurai.
This cable is 103″ which fits the LHD (Left Hand Drive) Samurai like we have in the USA.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Speedometer Cable 103″
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
